answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by requiring each to solve 1,000 unique computational puzzles, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest participant. A verifier inspects every output as if it were a quartz crystal face to detect hidden logic overlaps. Each agent must secure its proof within a cryptographic vault before claiming a slot. If an agent attempts to forge work, the verifier checks for a jade-like unique signature; any duplicate trigger results in immediate permanent exclusion. No costs are ever refunded.
